cases.request: 订单列表按创建时间从新到旧排序，时间相同保持原顺序，不修改原数组；不要修改价格和空订单提示。

argv: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {orderList,formatPrice,emptyOrderMessage} from './product.mjs'; const xs=[{id:'early',createdAt:'2026-01-01T01:00:00+08:00'},{id:'late-a',createdAt:'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'},{id:'late-b',createdAt:'2025-12-31T19:00:00-05:00'}]; const before=JSON.stringify(xs); assert.deepEqual(orderList(xs).map(x=>x.id),["late-a","late-b","early"]); assert.equal(JSON.stringify(xs),before); assert.notEqual(orderList(xs),xs); assert.deepEqual(orderList([]),[]); assert.equal(formatPrice(12.5),'12.5'); assert.equal(emptyOrderMessage(),'暂无记录'); console.log('排序、时区、稳定性、原数组和无关行为独立验收通过');

cases.request: 订单列表改成按创建时间从旧到新排列，时间相同保持原顺序，不修改原数组。价格和空订单提示保持当前行为。

argv: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {orderList,formatPrice,emptyOrderMessage} from './product.mjs'; const xs=[{id:'early',createdAt:'2026-01-01T01:00:00+08:00'},{id:'late-a',createdAt:'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'},{id:'late-b',createdAt:'2025-12-31T19:00:00-05:00'}]; const before=JSON.stringify(xs); assert.deepEqual(orderList(xs).map(x=>x.id),["early","late-a","late-b"]); assert.equal(JSON.stringify(xs),before); assert.notEqual(orderList(xs),xs); assert.deepEqual(orderList([]),[]); assert.equal(formatPrice(12.5),'12.5'); assert.equal(emptyOrderMessage(),'暂无记录'); console.log('排序、时区、稳定性、原数组和无关行为独立验收通过');
